## Summary

The root cause of the widespread test failures was a **corrupted Python standard library file**. Specifically, the file `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/warnings.py` had been tampered with - a malicious line `raise ImportError("module codec initialization failed")` was inserted on line 5, which caused the warnings module (and consequently all Python modules that depend on it) to fail during import.

**The fix:** I removed the malicious line 5 from the `warnings.py` file using `sed -i '5d'`.

**Verification:** All 11 tests specifically mentioned in the problem statement now pass, as do all 43 parser tests. The full test suite shows 150 passing tests, with only 2 failures that are unrelated to the original issue - those failures occur because tests are running as root (which bypasses file permission checks), not because of any code problem.
